name: SGCホール有明
notes: Initial simplified reconstruction from 31078.pdf. The reference image itself is only used for editing.
The source image was rendered at 5500x7750 and placed on a 7750x7750 white canvas with 1125px side margins to keep 1:1 coordinates.
SBL/SBR are modeled as independent 2F side balcony blocks with one row each so tickets such as 2階 SBL 2番 can be resolved after the parser's single-row fallback is enabled.
3F/4F side balcony labels such as LA-LK and RA-RK are modeled as rows inside large side blocks instead of separate blocks.
